newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saint Louis 96 net profit 710 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Saint Louis 96 net profit 710 mln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Note: the company gave the figures in a statement. The 573 million profit figure for 1995 included a 316 million provision for the restructuring of Arjo Wiggins Appleton.

Net attributable profit for 1996 took into account a capital gain from the sale of Panzalim, the back-dated amortisation of the redemption premium of the seven percent 1992 convertible bond as well as the write-down of various assets.

Net profit before exceptionals recovered in the second half of 1996 to 409 million francs from 284 million francs in the first half, helped by the improved contribution of the paper and sugar sectors.
